items.title: agentes-chat/agentes-chat
items.description: Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0.

Docker Soạn + Postgres. AGPL-3.0.

items.title: Show HN: A terminal-native idle factory game, written in Rust with ratatui
items.description: Hey HN readers! I'm snipedbywifi ( https://gitlab.com/snipedbywifi ), and i've been working on terminactory. Please try it out if you'd like to play a cozy factory game while waiting for long agent tasks to finish! The game is a factory game (overused niche, i know xD), but runs in your terminal. Reason i built it? glad you asked: So basically, it started off with me wanting a terminal-native factory game. Me and the modern 5.5 claude models made a base for the game that I liked, and then i went ham adding features / fixing some minor flaws (like adding claude code hooks so you recieve "telegrams" [the agent's responses], so you can review progress directly in-game). (yes, I had heavy AI assistance, disclaimer!!!) Right now, the game has basic factory features you'd expect from a game like this (build stuff, delete stuff, measure how much you're earning, basic selection tools), along with a few more..
